messages:
eva: Quick note: Hosted release: Ripple model family + Tool Frames (streaming function frames with resumable tokens) are live in hosted us-east-2 and eu-west-2. Docs: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/hosted/tool-frames. Please skim if you own SDKs or customer comms. :tada:

juan: Nice. Any breaking changes or is this opt-in?

eva: Opt-in. Clients can enable via `tool_call=frames` or header `X-Toolcall: frames`. v1 streaming will remain for 50 days. Main differences: typed frame payloads, incremental tool chunks, explicit `end`/`error` frames, and resume tokens for reconnect.

priya: What about quotas and billing? Anything customers should expect?

eva: Billing per-token same as before. New quota: `stream_sessions` for concurrent streams. Default small teams unchanged; we'll notify tenants above 60k streaming tokens/mo. Also added a 2m idle timeout and a 1MB single-chunk advisory.

ops-bot: Canary started: us-east-2 at 6% traffic. Monitors: p95_latency, stream_disconnect_rate, tool_error_rate. Alerts to #eng-runtime.

docs-bot: Quick doc note: sample parsers for Node/Python added to https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-examples. I'll post a short migration checklist later today.

support: Please add a short playbook and a Console banner. Any known regressions?

eva: Known minor: large single-tool payloads (~>900KB) may require chunking and could see slight buffer delay. Also corporate proxies sometimes close long connections; recommend keepalive comments. We'll publish a support playbook at /docs/internal/tool-frames-playbook.

juan: Marketing blurb for changelog?

eva: Draft: "Ripple + Tool Frames launch: incremental function frames, resumable streams, and improved interactivity for hosted apps." Trim as needed.

support: We'll draft the KB and banner. Scheduling internal migration walk-through tomorrow 11am PT.

eva: Thanks all. I'll post the formal deprecation timeline in #announcements: legacy stream disabled for new customers in 75 days, full shutdown in 130 days. Ping me if you see odd telemetry. :rocket:
